description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Heavy Mode I (Cinque)] and [Heavy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Heavy Mode I (Cinque)
description.text: Heavy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Heavy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Heavy abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Heavy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Heavy Mode II (Cinque)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Heavy Mode II (Cinque)
description.text: Equipped Heavy abilities deal 30% more damage, cast speed x999999 for equipped Heavy abilities, casts D Spirit after using equipped Heavy abilities

description.name: D Spirit
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 1] and [Dualcast Heavy 1]/[Damage Cap +10000 3] and [Dualcast Heavy 3] if 0-3/4+ Type-0 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
